result.title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MGRASRec：从用户-物品交互图检索协同过滤路径、并按多模态相似度扩展，将结构化路径注入 MLLM 提示，配合参数高效微调实现单次前向的序列推荐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用检索即时补充候选相关证据、并以单次前向替代反复推理的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理成本控制提供可核查线索，但全文未涉及 latent 推理状态或轨迹，关联较间接。
